== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Wei [[Grand Elder]] is the leader of the [[Wei clan]] and has been governing [[the Valley]] during the absence of [[Li Markuth]]. He is a figure of significant reputation, though his presence is often discussed by visiting elders. Physically, he possesses striking white circles in his eyes and carries a right arm encased in specialized bandages designed to suppress and conceal his strength, possibly due to the presence of a [[Divine Treasure]]. While he initially appeared to lack detectable [[madra]], his power is actually present but heavily muffled. During a formal challenge issued by [[Li Markuth]], the Wei [[Grand Elder]] appeared visibly unsettled but ultimately responded by ordering the evacuation of the arena.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Lindon{{!}}Wei Shi Lindon possesses black eyes featuring white irises that appear to glow. Their right arm is covered in bandages inscribed with [[scripts]] used to [[veil]] and restrain their power.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Lindon{{!}}Wei Shi Lindon is a [[Sage]] characterized by black eyes containing glowing white irises. His right arm is perpetually bound in scripted bandages that serve to [[veil]] and restrain his power. During the events at the arena, he took command by calling for a full evacuation of the area.}}
